hypothesis: On an RTX 4090 (driver 595.91.07, 24 GB) the host-visible device-local Vulkan type gives 8 GiB, so on the mapped path the pool is refused a block for each of the 6448 experts that find no room, and asks again each time with its mutex held. Remembering the size of the refused block should cut the tier's warm start (92.0 s) with the same experts on the card, the same nll range and the same speed.
